attributes.text: Green Street Expands Australian Coverage with Private Market Research and Data Across Five Markets and Three Sectors
Green Street debuts market grades, valuation metrics, forecasts and human-verified sales comps for Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney.

Green Street, the leading provider of Real Assets intelligence, data, news, and predictive analytics, today launched its Australian Private Market Research and Data offering, covering Industrial, Office and Retail for ‘B/B+’ quality grade assets across five markets: Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth and Sydney.

The new offering expands Green Street’s presence in the region. Green Street’s Australian public market research and REIT data were introduced in October 2025. Green Street News coverage of Australia is also available to subscribers. Together these resources give investors, lenders and advisers an independent view of Australian real estate, from listed REIT pricing to private market values and transactions.
For inquiries, please contact us at media@greenstreet.com.

Green Street is the leading global provider of actionable commercial Real Assets research, news, data, analytics, and advisory services. For over 40 years, Green Street has delivered unparalleled intelligence and trusted data on public and private markets, helping investors, banks, lenders, and other industry participants optimize investment and strategic decisions. Green Street delivers exclusive market information, conclusion-driven insights, and predictive analytics. Today, Green Street’s integrated platform serves more than 4,000 companies across North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. For more information, please visit greenstreet.com.
